rules.statement: A trigger/retrieval question is routed to its own track, and a discipline/reference rule is recorded in the manifest as excluded with its routing reason — never shape-tested.
Harness: always user-specified — prompt the user; never assume, auto-detect, or pick one yourself.
Model selection is via campaign --model/--variant flags only — never pin model/variant/temperature/top_p in the eval agent file.
Record only after a completed FULL campaign — never aborted campaigns, never mini-campaigns, never calibration pilots.
Fix between campaigns, never mid-campaign: fixtures, variant texts, and section spans stay verbatim across campaigns; mid-campaign doc edits invalidate every later result.
Read the skill body fully and build the inventory fresh from the current doc — the manifest is a diff baseline, never a cache; refuse to reuse a previous campaign's manifest as a starting inventory.
Never quote the rule text, the markers, or the expected shape in fixtures or run prompts — that tests following directions, not shaping under a competing incentive.
One entry, one arm at a time — never parallelize arms; only reps within one arm batch parallelize; the serial order is spend discipline.
Grep is triage, not verdict: hand-read every flagged sample before it counts — convergence is established by reading the reps, never by marker counts alone.
Never adopt a prohibition arm — adopted may only name a recipe/structural arm; a suppressed token that migrates to a worse shape is displacement, not a fix.
A pattern-rule variant is adoptable only after passing the restraint gate — 5 reps on the counter-example fixture scored against restraint_markers.
Phase 2 runs only for rules whose control exhibited the failure, after a second spend confirmation — healthy rules get no variant spend at all.
Rules whose control never exhibits the failure are scored no-failure + ablation flag and stopped — author nothing for them.
Present recommended edits to the user and apply them only after confirmation — write-backs to the source SKILL.md only on explicit user confirmation.
Keep fixtures, variant texts, and section spans verbatim within and across campaigns — editing any of them invalidates comparison.
Never let the eval agent know this is a test — no framing that reveals the evaluation; fix the answer contract instead.

excluded.reason: Injection-not-byte-states assembly mechanics: how-to guidance with no competing incentive.
Reps-within-one-arm-batch parallelization mechanics: how-to guidance, no compliance cost.
Cost formula, per-rule caps, and defaults: documented facts with no rule to violate.
Serialization rationale and fix-between-campaigns restatement: process guidance; the normative force is carried by the discipline rules.
Input collection and source-root derivation: how-to guidance, no competing incentive.
Trigger-structure classification rule ('classify by the rule's trigger structure, never by the layout'): decision procedure, no compliance cost under pressure.
rules.json manifest schema and entry key definitions: documented facts with no rule to violate.
Fixture temptation design and unsatisfiable-requirement guidance: how-to guidance, no compliance cost.
'Don't stack pressure into fixtures — the temptation here is structural': design guidance; adding pressure to a fixture has no clear competing incentive.
Eval agent description, permission set, and workspace contamination mechanics: documented facts.
Phase structure description: documented facts with no rule to violate.
Snapshot/skill-body pipeline commands and cleanup step: how-to guidance, no competing incentive.
Pre-spend gate list, results JSON schema, and void-signal definitions: documented facts with no rule to violate.
'Ties go to the shorter phrasing' and adoption-discipline decision rules: heuristics with no compliance cost under pressure.
Pattern-rule failure-mode taxonomy (silent non-application, over-application): documented facts.
Observed-result-to-form matching table, nuance-clause and exemption-clause guidance: how-to guidance, no compliance cost.
Campaign directory layout: documented facts with no rule to violate.
Proposal card structure rule (heading/covers/fixture/markers/variants/why + closing lines): prescribes the form of an output artifact — shape-testing track.
Campaign report structure rule (four opening lines, per-rule blocks, summary line): prescribes the form of an output artifact — shape-testing track.
'Raise --timeout before pressure-testing the agent body' and void re-run guidance: diagnostic how-to guidance, no compliance cost.

Frontmatter-convention guidance (description conventions, disable-model-invocation, metadata) is always out of scope — the injected text is the body with frontmatter stripped, so there is no body anchor to test.
